tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (433)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa tshal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang ting 'dzin dbang bskur dang bcas pa dngos grub yang snying zhes bya
(433)༄༅/ /dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa tshal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang ting 'dzin dbang bskur dang bcas pa dngos grub yang snying zhes bya

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (433)༄༅// dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa tshal lugs kyi sgrub thabs rjes gnang ting 'dzin dbang bskur dang bcas pa dngos grub yang snying zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

(434)༄༅// bdud bgegs kla klo kun 'joms shing*// sa lam bar chad sel mdzad pa'i// bla ma 'khor lo sdom pa dang*// dbyer med nag po che la 'dud// dpal rgwa lo tsā nas brgyud de bka' brgyud rin po cher bka' babs pa'i bstan srung kun gyi rgyal po ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa tshal lugs kyi rjes gnang bya ba la gsum/ sbyor ba/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ stegs bu'i steng du dkyil 'khor sgo med lha snam phyogs mdog can gyi dbus su// pad+ma sngon po 'dab brgyad lte ba dmar po la chos 'byung nag po zhig 'bri/ 'dab ma brgyad la tshom bu dmar po brgyad 'god/ chos 'byung la gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa zhig 'bri/ de'i steng du mañdzil bum pa/ rgyab tu dpal bshos snying gzugs mda' dar gyis brgyan pa/ mdun tu lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i gtor ma// g.yas su ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba/ g.yon du dam tshig gi rdo rje rnams bzhugs/ phyag mtshan 'be ta'i 'bras bu/ ral bri/ ka pā la/ tri shūl bzhi dang rgya gram rnams kyi tsakli bkod// mdun du 'bul gtor/ phyi mchod skor bsham mam phreng tshar gang bde/ nang mchod bdud rtsi/ nyer mkho gzhan yang tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa la sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang gnyis las/ dang po ni/ skyabs sems sngon du 'gro bas 'khor lo bde mchog gi bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung bzlas pa dang bcas (435)pa'i mthar 'od gsal du 'jug cing lhar ldangs/ mdun bskyed mchod pa rnams/ a mṛ tas bsad/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūm̐ zhu ba las/ mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ bsang gtor/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa/ mchod pa'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ghaṃ swā hā/ pā d+yam̐/

ā ñtsa ma nam̐/ pro k+ṣa nam̐/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke /gan+dhe/ nai wi te/ shab+da/ oṃ badz+ra ghāṇ+ḍa ra ṇi ta sogs kyis byin dbab/ rten yod na de nyid bskyed dgos shing*/ med na gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar bskyed pa yin te/ de yang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho ྅haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur khang med dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang*/ rang gi mdun du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang bcas shing ro dang*/ ro langs (436)dang srin po dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor la paṃ las pad+ma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan du gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba zhig 'phros te gdan steng du 'khod/ hūm̐ de nyid kyi 'od kyi 'phro 'du las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de las 'od 'phros/ dgra bgegs gdugs pa can thams cad tshar bcad de gnas spar/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la dpa' bo chen po sku mdog mthing nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum ldang mig tu gzigs pa/ zhal gdangs shing mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'dril zhing*/ ha ha dang hūm̐ hūm̐ dang phaṭa phaṭa kyi gad rgyangs sgrog pa/ sma ra/ smin ma/ dbu skra ser po me ltar 'bar ba/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang pos 'be ta'i 'bras bu snying dang 'dra ba dang*/ g.yon gyi dang pos ka pā la khrag gis gang ba thugs kar steng 'og tu 'dzin pa/ g.yas 'og mas ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing*/ g.yon 'og mas tri shū las mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dar dpyangs dang bcas pa 'phyar stabs su bsnams pa/

mi mgo skam po lngas dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rtse phran dang*/ sbrul rigs bzhi dang*/ rus pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la dpa' bo rol ba'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /'dir yi ge gsar pa 'ga' na tri shū la kho na yod pa dang*/ yig rnying phal cher na/ phyag mtshan tri shū la'i dod du rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ ga yod cing*/ rus rgyan ma bshad pa ltar yang rung ngo*/ /de'i thugs (437)ka nas hūm̐ gsum spros te mdun du 'khod pa ni/ sku gsung thugs las sprul pa'i las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag /khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can mi'u thung gi rnam pa rdo rje gnam lcags kyi mchu dang ldan pa'i bya rog gi gdong khro gnyer bsdus shing spyan gsum pa/ g.yas gri gug 'phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing zhal du rngub pa/ zhabs brkyang bskum gyi dor stabs can/ dug sbrul nag pos brgyan cing*/ skra mtshams nas rdo rje bya khyung spro ba/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs can gsum du gyur/ de gsum gyi g.yas su sha za nag po seng ge'i gdong pa can ral gri dang thod khrag 'dzin pa/ g.yon brkyang pa'i gar stabs can/ dar nag gi na bza' dkris pa gsum/ g.yon tu tsaṇ+ḍi kā dmar mo zhal gcig phyag bzhi'i g.yas gnyis ral gri thod khrag /g.yon gnyis mi mgo dang mda' gzhu 'dzin pa/ gcer bu khro zhing sgeg pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa gsum/ gtso bo'i g.yon tu lha mo re ma tī ral gri dang ne'u le 'dzin pa/ de'i mdun du e ka dzā ṭi dmar nag phyag bzhi pa rtse gsum mi snying thod rlon lcags spyang khra thogs kyi tshul can du 'khod pa'o// de'i phyi rol sgo mtshams brgyad du yi ge ma brgyad yongs su gyur pa las/

shar du mkha' 'gro ma bya rgod kyi gdong pa can/ byang du khyung gi gdong pa can/ nub tu khā ta'i= lhor 'ug pa'i= shar lhor phag gi= lho nub tu khyi'i= nub byang du spyang ki'i= byang shar du stag gi gdong pa can/ brgyad ka'ang dmar mo gcer bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i stang stabs sna tshogs pas gnas pa/ 'khor de dag thams cad kyang dbu skra gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ (438)mi mgo'i dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ mi ro'i gdan la rnam par 'gying pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o// de'i phyi rol du nag po stong*/ sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba/ lha srin sde brgyad kyi tshogs thams cad kyis bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang*/ mgon po'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ 'og min dang*/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal/ na len+d+ra/ dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas/ mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ hūm̐/ dad pa dang ni dam tshig gis// tshur gshegs ma hā kā la'i tshogs// bdag gis thugs dam gnyan bskong na// dur khrod gnas nas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan 'bul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ mgon po'i spyi bor 'khor lo la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ sngon po/ yang rang gi thugs ki'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ār+ghaṃ ma nas/ shab+da 'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur du gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing*/ bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /mthu stobs dang nus mthu la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/

ye shes mgon po la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan/ 'khor rnams la gtso bo nyid kyis dbu brgyan par gyur/ de nas mchod pa ni/ spro na mchod phreng tshigs bcad yig rnying las 'byung ba rnams bya/ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ de bzhin tu/ pā d+yaṃ/ āñtsa ma (439)naṃ/ prok+ṣa naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tu/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+ye/ shap+ta/ zhes phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes nang mchod dang*/ hūm̐/ gzi brjid sku yis srid gsum zil gyis gnon// gsung gi bzhad sgras sde brgyad bran du 'khol// brtse ba'i thugs kyis 'gro drug dbang du sdud// lha chen dpal 'bar nag po khyod la bstod// bka' yi pho nya nag po'i gtso// bya rog gdong can 'jigs pa'i gzugs// khros pa'i cha lugs rngams pa'i zhal// dam nyams srog gcod khyod la 'dud// dpal ldan lha mo tsaṇ+ḍi kā /lha min mu stegs tshogs 'joms shing*// nad kyi bdag mo drag shul can// srog la dbang bsgyur khyod la bstod// bsil ba'i tshal gyi shing gcig drung*// nag po chen po seng ge'i gdong*// zhing skyong sha za chen po ste// dpal gyi bka' sdod khyod la bstod// gzhan yang mkha' 'gro chen po brgyad// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba sde brgyad bcas// kun la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ rdo rje rtse lnga'i phyag rgya bstan la/ oṃ ma hā kā la sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod cing dam la bzhag /de nas bsnyen sgrub dang rjes gnang skabs 'dir bzlas pa bya ste/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa mang yang spyi tsam du do li'am khyogs kyi bzlas ba ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sngon po byung*/ zhal nas 'thon te mgon po'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ sngon po gnas pa la thim pas thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/

de las 'od zer sngon po byung ste lte ba nas brgyud/ rang gi lte ba nas zhugs te thugs srog la thim pas byin rlabs dngos grub thams cad thob par bsam/ de la brtan pa thob nas 'od zer sngags phreng du bsgyur/ de la bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nya ེ (440) snying dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu ba ma hā kā la hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces snying po dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ka wu wa wa ba sha ya ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces khyad par gyi snying po'o// de nas rtsa sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis mgon po bskul ba dang*/ 'khor sngags la mgon po'i thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis 'khor rnams bskul/ so so'i sku las sprul pa'i pho nya dpag tu med pa spros te phrin las bzhi thogs med du bsgrubs/ khyad par bstan dgra la mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las mdzad par dmigs/ de la shā sa na rtsa ba'i sngags yin la/ oṃ karma ma hā kā lā ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las mgon gyi snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la gu ṇa hṛ da hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtso bo las mgon sbrags pa'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la ka ka mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ las mgon gyi mtshan sngags dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā lī de wī waṃ hri hūm̐ phaṭa/ tsaṇ+ḍi kā'i snying po dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza du tri phu tri hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sha za seng ge gdong gi sngags dang*/ ma ma trag ru dra mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ lha mo'i sngags so/ /gtor chog kho na byed skabs bzlas pa mi dgos pas dam bzhag gi 'phros su rkang brgyad lan gsum sogs 'don nas gtor 'bul la 'jug /skabs 'dir/ mdun gyi gtor ma dang*/ bum pa'i nang thod pa'i dbus/ rdo rje rnams ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa lha mo'i 'khor gyis bskor ba bde mchog gi dbu rgyan can re re gsal bar gyur/ ces dmigs la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha badz+ra ḍā ki nī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa gsum sbrel gang nus zhig bzla/ de nas rkang pa brgyad pa'i bstod pa/ oṃ/ 'grub par gyur cig /hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces drag po'i sgra yis srid pa gsum gyi khongs ni ma lus 'gengs nus shing*// hā hā ṭ+ṭā ṭ+ṭā zhes bzhad gang zhig dus kun tu ni shin tu rab tu 'jigs mdzad pa// kaṃ kaṃ kaṃ zhes thod pa'i phreng bas dbu la spras shing nag po'i mchu dang mtshungs pa'i sku// bh+rūṃ bh+rūm̐ bh+rūṃ zhes nus pa mchog gi khro gnyer 'jigs mdzad 'jigs pa'i kha gdangs sha za zhing*// dbu skra dang ni sma ra ches ser (441)nye bar bskyod pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis bsrung bar mdzod// raṃ raṃ raṃ zhes spyan dmar 'khrug cing sgyur mdzad krūm̐ krūm̐ krūm̐ zhes rab khros spyan gyis gzigs// smin ma ser zhing mche gtsigs ro yi gdan la dgyes pa'i zhing skyong khyod kyis zhing skyong mdzod// hā hā hūm̐ dang ki li ki li zhes sgrogs phyog g.yon kha ṭ+waṃ gar bcas thod pa bsnams// ru ru ru zhes khrag rgyun 'babs pa phyag gis bsnams shing gsol mdzad 'thung ba la dgyes shing*// kham̐ kha ྃkham̐ zhes gtum bo'i phyag g.yas gri gug ral gris bgegs rnams la ni rol mdzad pa// ḍam̐ ḍam̐ ḍa ྃzhes ḍā ma ru can 'di yis gdul mdzad 'khor bcas zhing skyong khyod gyis srungs// rab tu rngam zhing mgo bo rnams kyi phreng bas gshin rje dang mtshungs 'jigs pa'i sku brgyan cing*// k+ṣīṃ k+ṣīṃ k+ṣīṃ zhes bzod pa'i gzugs can ca co sgrogs par byed pa'i gdug pa rnams bzung ste// gcig pus sna tshogs mnan cing mnan nas ka ha ka ha brjod mdzad char sprin sngon po'i mdog /sku la mi yi sha dang rgyu mas sgrel ba'i phreng bas kun nas brgyan cing zhal du gsol// drag shul phyag gis 'dod pa'i gzugs dang mi sdug gzugs can gyi ni 'byung po'i ro longs tshogs// ma lus bzung nas myur du bsad pa rnams kyi mgo bo khrag rgyun 'bab pa rab tu gsol// hrīṃ k+ṣum̐ shri'i sngags kyi gsung can pa tsa pa tsa'i sngags kyis bgegs rnams rab tu bsregs// rol pas rol pa ser zhing mi yis gang ba'i sa la zhing skyong khyod kyis srung bar mdzod// pheṃ pheṃ pheṃ zhes sgrogs pas so sor bskyod pa'i me dpung che'i po'i dbus su bzhugs nas su// rigs kyi lus can skyong bar mdzod cig sgrub po rnams kyi zhing rnams nges par zhing skyong mdzod// phyugs rnams kyi ni nyin re bzhin tu bgegs dang sdig 'joms dri med brnyes pa chu nyi (442)bzhin// tsaṃ tsaṃ tsaṃ zhes gtum po'i shugs kyis rab g.yos rmad byung sa yi 'jig rten snang mdzad la// kram̐ kram̐ kram̐ zhes gshegs pas dgra bo nyon mongs pa rnams nges par nyon mongs 'joms mdzad cing*// sam̐ sa ྃsam̐ zhes tshogs pa'i bdag nyid dam tshig thos 'dzin zhing skyong gang yin khyod kyis skyongs// baṃ bam̐ baṃ zhes gshin rje ltar khro dri ma med pa'i sna tshogs chu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// yam̐ yam̐ yam̐ zhes rlung gi shugs kyis myur du rgyu zhing nyon mongs 'jig rten gnod byed mkhyen// klām̐ klām̐ klām̐ zhes gdug pa'i gzugs kyis srid gsum nyin mtshan dus kun nyon mongs gyur pa gang*// k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ k+ṣaṃ zhes phan par mdzad cing gnod pa skad cig gis sel zhing skyong khyod kyis skyongs// pam̐ pam̐ pam̐ zhes thugs rje'i zhags pas byol song rnams 'dzin phyag gis gdul bya rnams skyong ba/

sngags bdag sngags kyi gzugs can thugs kyis sngags pa rnams la blo gros 'bras bu mtshungs med ster// zhing rnams skyong bar mdzad pa khyod kyis 'gro ba'i lus rnams ma lus yun ring bskyang du gsol// sgrub pa po'am slob dpon gang zhig dam tshig thos 'dzin gang zhig blo ldan gyur pa dag /thun gsum du ni sngags rnams brgyad po klog byed de ni bsod nams ldan par 'gyur ba dang*// tshe dang dpal dang grags dang mthu stobs 'byor ba 'dzin dang gzi brjid rgyas ba mtshungs med ster// sa steng dang ni mtho ris su yang de yi bgegs kyi tshogs ni rtag tu nyams par 'gyur/

zhes byin rlabs can gyi bstod pa brjod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ a mri ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ las rlung*/ ram̐ las me/ kaṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du/ go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi mu shu ma ra las bdud rtsi lnga/ thod pa'i steng du (443)zla ba'i kha gcod hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po// oṃ dkar po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa rnams mgo bo mthur bstan/ rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing 'dres/ rang gi gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum las 'od 'phros/ gtor ma'i steng gi 'bru gsum la phog /mas rim gyis gtor ma la thim pas/ gtor ma bdud rtsi sngo dmar dkar po'i rnam par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ lan gsum/ rdo rjes bdud rtsi lan gsum du dkrugs/ rdo rje lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te gnyis su med par thim/ rdo rje yang zhu zhing 'dres pa las/ gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ 'di ni 'di nyid kyi man ngag las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin gyis rlabs pa'i lugs yin la/ yi dam gang byed de'i cho ga las 'byung ba'i gtor ma byin rlabs/ de nyid gyis kyang nges par rung ngo*/ /mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kā la i daṃ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/ lan bdun gyis gtso bo dang*/ 'khor rnams la spro na/ snying po lan gsum gyis dbul zhing*/ gtso 'khor thams cad kyi thun mong du/ rtsa sngags kyis dbul ba ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ma hā kā lā ya/ shā sa na u pa hā ri ṇi e ṣo3 pash+tsi ma/

kā lo a yaṃ/ i daṃ rat+na tra yā ya/ a pa kā ri ṇaṃ/ ya di pra ti dzña/ sma ra si ta dā/ i daṃ duṣ+ṭaṃ/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ mā ra mā ra/ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ di na me ke na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum mo// 'di ni rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring po ltar na/ shā sa na gcig pus chog /bsdus pa ltar na/ gtso bo'i gtor sngags thung ngu des kyang chog go /gtor chog kho na'i skabs/ de (444)rjes gsham nas 'byung ba'i 'dod don gsol gdab la 'jug /gnyis pa rjes gnang ni/ gong gi gtor 'bul grub pa dang*/ slob ma rnams la phyi rol du chab btang*/ gral la 'khod de me tog bkye bsdu bya/ sems bskyed gsal gdab la/ de la sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dang dkar po'i phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi nang nas mthu stobs phrin las khyad par du 'phags pa ni ye shes kyi ma mgon lcam dral rnams yin la/ dpal nag po chen po lcam dral la'ang rigs mang du mchis pa rnams kyi nang nas bcom ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i thugs las sprul pa'i ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa 'di la spyi dang bye brag gi rgyud grub thob so so'i bka' srol gyi man ngag shin tu mang bar bzhugs shing 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis rgya gar na len+d+ra'i gtsug lag khang gi srung ma'i gtso bor mnga' gsol/ mu stegs kla klo'i gnyen por yang 'di nyid kho nar bsngags/ bod yul 'dir yang bka' srol snga phyi mang du byon pa'i nang nas skabs su babs pa 'di ni/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog dang dbyer med pa'i dpal chen rgwa lo tsā ba nyid dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i tshe mgon bo 'di nyid dngos su zhal gzigs nas sgrub thabs sogs rgyas par phul ba nas bzung ste ye shes mgon po nyid dus rtag tu 'bral med du gzigs/ lo tsā ba nyid bod du phebs pa'i skabs bod yul che dgu kun gyis zhabs la btud cing*/

gdams ngag zhus pa la so so'i snod dang mtshams pa'i chos sbyin brtsal/ khyad par mgon po 'di nyid kyi rgyud dang man ngag /sgrub thabs kyi skor rnams/ bka' brgyud rin po che'i grub chen rnams la/ so so'i bka' babs dang mtshungs par gnang ba las/ 'dir 'gro ba'i mgon po zhang tshal pa nas brgyud pa'i lugs kyi rjes su gnang ba bsgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyis bgyi bang 'os pa rnams grub pa lags/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la thog (445)mar zhu ba'i yon tu dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba zhu/ zhes brda sbyar la maṇ+ḍal 'bul gzhug /de nas slob dpon bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog dngos su gsal ba la mos gus byas te thal mo me tog dang bcas te gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos/ sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod pa dang*// log 'dren bgegs rnams tshar gcod phyir// mgon po'i dbang bskur bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ de nas rgyud rnam par dag par bya ba'i slad du/ mdun bskyed dpal ye shes mgon po'i dkyil 'khor rtsa brgyud bla ma rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mngon sum bzhin du bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar rgyun bshags sngon tu 'gro ba'i byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal thob la 'di'i rjes zlos// dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum/ de nas rjes gnang dngos kyi thog ma byin rlabs kyi gzhi 'god pa'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ bla ma he ru ka'i thugs ka nas 'od zer sngon po thog lhung ba ltar byung ste/ slob ma'i lus la g.yon bskor lan gsum byas nas spyi bor thim pas/ ma dag pa'i lus sbyangs te/ 'od zer mthing kha'i phung po chen por gyur/ de las dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i dbus su/ pad nyi'i gdan la hūm̐ las rdo rje gri gug hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od 'phros/

zhes pa nas/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis mgon po'i skur gsal btab/ bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'phros/ bsil ba tshal na len+d+ra// dpal gyi ri la sogs pa nas// ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa 'ur 'ur chem chem gyi sgra dang bcas te byon/ slob ma la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ sngags drag tu bzla/ de (446)nas dbang gi lha dpal ye shes kyi mgon po'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ ār+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa sogs/ sgrub thabs kyi dbang bskur skabs ltar la/ oṃ badz+rī bha ba/ zhes pa'i skabs bdud rtsi kā pā las dbang bskur/ 'thor 'thur bya/ zhes gsungs zhing bdud rtsi'i bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun gyis spyi bo gang bas bum dbang*/ mgrin par gang bas gsang dbang*/ snying khar gang bas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang*/ lte bar gang bas dbang bzhi pa thob/ dri ma dag /lam sgom pa la dbang bar byas/ chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil ba las/ mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs lnga'i dbur brgyan par gyur/ de nas bum pas dbang bskur la/ oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba bud+dha badz+ra ḍā ki nī shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭa/ a bhi ṣiñtsi/ zhes brjod/ de nas sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa'i dbang rnams rim par bskur bas so so'i bsgrag tshig dang mthun par sdig sgrib dag /dbang dang byin rlabs rgyud la zhugs par mos shig /gtor ma mgor bzhag la/ dam rdzas gtor ma'i dbang bskur bas// sku'i byin rlabs lus la zhugs// lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// sku mi 'gyur tshe yi dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ bdud rtsi lce la sbyin te/ dam rdzas bdud rtsi'i dbang bskur bas// gsung gi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// ngag gi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// gsung mi 'gyur nus mthu'i dbang thob shog

/oṃ ma hā kā la wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ rdo rje'i dbang ni/ rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ stong nyid rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// thugs kyi byin rlabs yid la zhugs// yid kyi sgrib pa dag gyur nas// thugs mi 'gyur 'od gsal dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ yon tan phyag mtshan rnams lag g.yas (447)g.yon tu gtad la/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// 'be ta'i 'bras bu dbang bskur bas// rin chen gter gyi char pa 'bebs// longs spyod dngos grub dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la bhe tsa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// shes rab ral gri'i dbang bskur bas// nyon mongs dug gsum rtsad nas bcad// dgra bgegs 'dul ba'i dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la khaḍ+ga= hūm̐/ ngo mtshar rmad= /ban+dha thod pa'i dbang bskur bas// thugs zhi bas bdud bzhi 'joms// byang chub sems kyi dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la ka pā la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ ngo mtshar rmad du= /rtse gsum kha ṭ+wāṃ dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs dang ldan gyur te// sku gsum yon tan dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la hri shū la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ phrin las kyi dbang ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gtad la/ hūm̐/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba yi// sna tshogs rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas// zhi rgyas dbang drag mthu brnyes nas// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dbang thob shog /oṃ ma hā kā la sarba karma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de nas gtor ma dpal 'bar btsugs pa slob ma'i mgo thog tu bzung la/ phrin las gtor ma'i bka' bsgo ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gtor snod dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po'i nang du gtor ma ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa bcu bdun 'khor dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas par gsal thob/ de'i steng du slob dpon dang 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor dbyer ma mchis pa la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor bar sgoms shig

/bla ma yi dam gyi tshogs kyis chos skyong srung ma rnams la bka' bsgos pas/ de rnams kyis rdo rje'i bro drag po 'khrabs pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad thal bar brlag par mos pa gyis/ zhes brjod la/ rol mo'i sgra drag po dang bcas te/ bstod pa (448)brgyad pa tshar gcig dang*/ shā sa na dang sngags rnams tshar gcig drag tu brjod pa'i rjes la/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po phyag bzhi pa lcam dral/ bran g.yog bka' sdod pho nya las mkhan 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang*// gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ in+d+ra bhū ti/ lha lcam legs smin/ klu'i bu thub pa mi/ sgra gcan 'dzin bzang po// 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ār+ya de ba/ slob dpon rta dbyangs/ dus 'khor zhabs/ a bha yā ka ra/ tsa mi sangs rgyas grags// dpal chen rgwa lo tsā/ zhang g.yu brag pa chen po// 'gro mgon gtsang pa rgya ras la sogs pa rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar slob ma 'di'i srung ma chen po mdzod la/ lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'grogs te/ 'gal rkyen bar gcod mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad sol/ mthun rkyen chos bzhin gyi bsam don mtha' dag yid bzhin tu sgrubs/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis bde blag tu 'grub pa'i sdong grogs g.yel ba med par mdzad du gsol/ zhes bka' bsgo bya/ mthar bla ma rnams yi dam la thim/ de rnams mgon po 'khor dang bcas pa la thim/ de rnams 'od du zhu nas slob ma la thim par gyur/ ces dpon slob gnyis car gyis bsgom/ mgon po bsgrub par 'dod pa yin na bzlas lung sbyin dgos pas/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung blang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ slob dpon la mos gus dung pa byas pas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de'i thugs kar nyi steng hūm̐ yig sngags phreng sngon pos bskor ba las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/

zhal nas thon/ khyed rang rnams mgon por gsal ba'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor hūm̐ yig sngon po'i mthar 'khod/ de'i (449)dus su phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams kyi byin rlabs nus pa thams cad 'jug par gyur cig /ces dang*/ de nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar 'os pa brjod/ dam tshig khas blang*/ gtong rag maṇ+ḍal sogs rjes kyi bya ba spyi dang 'dra/ gsum pa rjes chog ni/ gtor mchod rnams kha gso ba la longs yod na slar yang gtor 'bul bya/ gang ltar phyi nang gi sngags mchod 'bul/ bstod pa bsdus pas bstod/ rdo rje nag po chen po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod sbyin gtor ma 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ sems can la bde skyid kyi dpal rgya chen po 'byung ba dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi bsam sbyor phun tshogs chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub pa dang*/ bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi zhing*/ dgra bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa la sogs pa phrin las rnam pa bzhi g.yel ba med par mdzod du gsol/ yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs bya/ med na badz+ra muḥ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim/ āt+ma ka tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod la theg pa chen po'i skyon lam dang zhal nas gsungs pa'i tshigs su bcad pa sogs kyis shis brjod bya'o// ༈ /thel lugs dang tshal lugs kyi brgyud pa gnyis car gcig tu dril pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur khyad par can ni/ maṇ+ḍal la me tog gi tshom bu mthing nag gcig gam 'khor can byed na/ de mdun gsum bsgrig /de rgyab brgyad bkod pa'i steng du rkang gsum khar dpal gtor nag gi gdugs phub pa bzhag

/gtor mchod spyi mthun bshams/ bdag bskyed bde mchog dang mthun bskyed mgon po gtso rkyang bskyed kyang (450)chog /'khor bcas ltar na/ bya rog gdong can gsum dang*/ mkha' 'gro brgyad kho nas bskor ba bskyod/ sgrub tshul gzhan thams cad snga ma dang mtshungs/ dbang dngos la khrus dang*/ sems bskyed gsal gdab/ 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan srung kun gyi rgyal po// khrag 'thung kun gyi spyi rje/ dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad kyi gnyen po// rdo rje nag po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs man ngag gi bka' srol du byung ba thams cad kyi nang nas khyad par du 'phags pa dpal chen rgwa lo tsā ba'i lugs 'di la'ang brgyud pa'i srol ka mang du mchis pa'i nang nas/ dpal ldan phag mo grub nas stag lung thang pa chen po la brgyud pa dang*/ 'gro mgon zhang tshal pa nas chos rje gtsang pa rgya ras sogs la brgyud pa ste lugs gnyis gcig tu dril ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur khyad par can bsgrub pa la/ sogs kyis mtshams sbyar nas maṇ+ḍal 'bul du gzhug /gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin rgyal gtso// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mthu stobs phrin las gcig bsdus pa// khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol// zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod kyi// dngos grub bdag gis thob par shog

/lan gsum/ rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed kyi dmigs pa phog la/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sogs lan gsum gyi rjes zlos byar gzhug /de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba dngos la dmigs pa 'di rnams rim bzhin tu sgoms shig /bla ma dpal 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba dang mdun bskyed ye shes mgon po'i dpral ba nas sku'i mgon po dkar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar thim pas sku'i rjes su gnang ba thob cing byin rlabs zhugs par mos shig /yang bla ma dang ye shes mgon po'i mgrin pa nas gsung gi mgon po dmar po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon (451)te khyed rang rnams kyi mgrin par thim pas gsung gi rjes su gnang ba thob cing byin rlabs zhugs par mos shig /yang bla ma dang ye shes mgon po'i thugs ka nas thugs kyi mgon po mthing ga'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon te khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim pas thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing byin rlabs zhugs par mos shig /yang bla ma dang ye shes mgon po'i lte ba nas yon tan gyi mgon po ser po'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi lte bar thim pas yon tan gyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing byin rlabs zhugs par mos shig /yang bla ma dang ye shes mgon po'i gsang gnas nas phrin las mgon po ljang gu'i tshogs dpag tu med pa byon nas khyed rang rnams kyi gsang gnas su thim pas phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba thob cing byin rlabs zhugs par mos shig /ces rim par brjod la bar mtshams rnams su cung zad re 'jog /gtor ma me sgron btsugs pa thogs la/ des ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba dngos gzhi song nas mtha' rten gtor pa'i dbang bskur ba la dmigs pa 'di ltar du mdzod cig /gtor snod dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i nang du gtor ma ye shes mgon po phyag bzhi pa/

mdun tu bya rog gdong can gsum/ de rgyab mkha' 'gro brgyad kyis bskor ba/ steng gi cha la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang bcas pa/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bor spyan drangs shing byin gyis brlabs pas sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub ma lus pa thob/ phrin las rnam pa bzhi thogs med du sgrub par mos shig /spro na gong smos bzhin brgyud pa gnyis ka'i mtshan smos la bka' bsgo bya/ bsdu na sngags brjod la mgor bzhag pas 'thus/ de nas lha mo brgyad kyi thugs ka nas bya rog gdong can dpag tu med pa dang bar snang gang ba tsam byon/ lha mo brgyad dang*/ de rnams thams cad ba (452)spu'i bu ga nas thim par mos shig /gu ṇa hri da'i sngags drag tu brjod/ dam pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po las kyi mgon po bya rog gi gdong pa can gyis rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam tshig gnyan po las ma g.yel bar rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la lus dang grib ma bzhin tu 'grogs te/ byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'gal rkyen mi mthun pa thams cad sel zhing mthun rkyen legs tshogs yid bzhin tu sgrub cing rtag tu srung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las mdzad du gsol/ ces gtor ma mgor bzhag cing lag tu gtad/ de nas khyed rang rnams skad cig gis dpal ye shes kyi mgon po ma hā kā la dpa' bo chen po sogs mngon rtogs ltar la/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na pad+ma nyi ma zhing chen bsnol ba'i gdan la dpa' bo rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis bzhugs pa'i skur gsal thob/ de nas bzlas pa'i lung blang ba la dmigs pa 'di bzhin tu mdzod/ ces pa nas/ nus pa thams cad 'jug par gyur cig /ces pa'i bar bzlas lung gong smos ltar bya/ bkra shis brjod/ dam tshig bzung ba sogs rjes rnams sngar smos pa ltar ro// 'di khrid dang 'brel ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur ba yin pas shin tu gces par bzung dgos shing byin rlabs shin tu che ba myong bas kyang grub gsungs so// 'khrul rtog dgra bgegs ltar snang ba// gnyis med ye shes nag po che'i// bde chen dra bar rab bsdams nas// srid zhi mnyam nyid chen por shog

/ces gangs ljongs sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad kyi khrid srol gces par bsdus pa gdams ngag rin po che'i mdzod las mnyam med dwags po bka' brgyud kyi chos srung gi gtso bor bsngags pa 'di la rgyud gzhung man ngag mtha' yas pa gzhungs las/ sgrub thabs rjes gnang gi snying po jo nang rin 'byung du bzhugs pa las zur phyung bklag chog gi tshul du karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos rdzong shod bde gshegs 'dus pa'i pho brang du bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/// /
